stories.title: Xbox Game Pass Is Losing 8 More Games In October
stories.summary: It's that time of month when Xbox updates the Game Pass library, and, as usual, a few more games are leaving the subscription service in a few weeks. On October 31, you can say goodbye to 8 more games, including a few LucasArts classics, a diggy-diggy blast of co-op fun, and one of the biggest Lego Star Wars games of all time. sources.title: Xbox Game Pass recebe Battlefield 6 e mais jogos esta semana! Veja os lançamentos (17)
sources.text: O Xbox Game Pass é um dos serviços de assinatura de games mais democráticos da atualidade, já que é possível acessá-lo de diferentes plataformas — incluindo os próprios, consoles da Microsoft, assim como no PC, nuvem, celulares, tablets e até Smart TVs Samsung e LG com modelos de 2022 para cá. Felizmente, seu catálogo também é atualizado quase que semanalmente, trazendo inúmeras opções para os assinantes aproveitarem — e o melhor de tudo: gastando pouco em comparação às novas tendências de preços da indústria. Se veio em busca de novos jogos para jogar através do Xbox Game Pass , está no lugar certo. O serviço ganhou um reforço de peso esta semana com a chegada de seis títulos para os assinantes aproveitarem. Confira abaixo mais informações sobre as novas aventuras! Battlefield 6 aposta em combates intensos, guerra em larga escala e destruição tática nos cenários. Assinantes do EA Play podem resgatar pacotes especiais e receber recompensas sazonais, enquanto usuários do Game Pass Ultimate também têm acesso ao serviço e a 10% de desconto em compras digitais elegíveis da EA. Desenvolvido no Brasil, Deep Dish Dungeon é um jogo de exploração e sobrevivência ambientado em uma masmorra artesanal repleta de quebra-cabeças. Com elementos de metroidvania e criação de itens, o título permite explorar suas profundezas sozinho ou em partidas cooperativas online. O jogo chegou em day one ao Xbox Game Pass. Dos criadores de Ghostrunner , Valor Mortis é um soulslike de ação em primeira pessoa ambientado em uma versão sobrenatural da era napoleônica. Na pele de um ex-soldado que retorna dos mortos, os jogadores enfrentam criaturas monstruosas, utilizam poderes especiais e investigam uma conspiração que ameaça a humanidade. O título também chegou em day one ao Xbox Game Pass. Em Bluey’s Happy Snaps , os jogadores exploram cenários conhecidos da série animada com Bluey e Bingo em uma aventura focada em fotografia. A experiência permite registrar momentos, descobrir animais da fauna australiana e jogar sozinho ou com uma segunda pessoa. Além disso, o jogo chegou em day one ao Xbox Game Pass. Chained Beasts , outro título day one do serviço, é um roguelike cooperativo para até quatro jogadores, que precisam enfrentar batalhas em arenas enquanto permanecem acorrentados uns aos outros. A mecânica permite usar as correntes e o próprio cenário para derrotar adversários, sobreviver a confrontos contra chefes e avançar pelos desafios. Por fim, em Beyond These Stars , que também chegou em day one no Game Pass, os jogadores constroem e administram uma cidade nas costas de uma baleia espacial enquanto viajam pelo universo. É necessário organizar cadeias de suprimentos, atender às necessidades dos habitantes, estabelecer postos avançados e interagir com espécies alienígenas para descobrir os mistérios do espaço. Curtiu as indicações para jogar no Xbox Game Pass? Vale a pena dar uma conferida em Battlefield 6 , hein? sources.title: XBOX Game Pass Will Remove 8 More Games in October
sources.text: The next set of games leaving the XBOX Game Pass library in October 2026 has been revealed, and players will see 8 more removed. When the first wave of XBOX Game Pass titles for October 2026 was announced, players learned that nine games would be removed from the library that month. As we approach the second wave of games, the next set of titles slated for removal has also been revealed. Check out the list below: As spotted by GameSpot , the list of games leaving XBOX Game Pass library has been updated, and the 8 games will be removed on October 31, 2026. One of the biggest titles that will be removed this month is LEGO Star Wars: Skywalker Saga, which is an action-adventure title that covers all the 9 Skywalker Saga movies in one game, with 300 playable characters to choose from plus 100 vehicles, 23 planets to explore, local and online co-op, and much more. Other than that, if you are a fan of Lara Croft, then Temple of Osiris could be a new experience to check out. It is the first-ever four-player co-op experience in the franchise, where players get to explore the Egyptian underworld. Players should note that they still have a few days to try the games out, and if they want to keep playing, they can also grab them at a discount. Here’s the full list of games leaving Game Pass in the second half of October: What are your thoughts on the eight games leaving Game Pass in October? Leave your thoughts down in the comments, and join the official Insider Gaming Discord server . For more information from Insider Gaming, read about The Finals adding dynamic commentary that says your actual player name . Don’t forget to sign up for our weekly newsletter .

sources.title: The Saros: Zenith update out today, brings more ways to play for newcomers and veterans alike
sources.text: Boss rush mode, New Game+, new gameplay modifiers, trophies, accessibility options and more. Starting today (October 19) the Saros : Zenith update is available to all Saros owners for no additional charge. We had two main goals for this update: add replayability for existing players who had already plumbed the depth of Carcosa, and make the game more accessible so Saros even more people can discover the addictive, explosive, exhilarating bullet ballet gameplay that made Saros one of the highest rated action games of 2026. To begin, I’d like to introduce some of the features that make Saros more accessible for new players to pick up and play. At Housemarque, a feeling we chase with our designs is the satisfaction that comes from facing down a difficult challenge, then overcoming it. Because of this, we are always wary about adjusting difficulty by toning down the parts of the game that create these interesting challenges: i.e. the spectacular attacks coming at you from our enemies. Although we realize our games can look intimidating at first, we didn’t want to compromise the combat system of Saros by reducing the projectiles that put the “bullet” in “bullet ballet”. With this setting enabled, you can slow the game down to give yourself more time to react to hostile attack telegraphs, see the bullets as they fly towards you, and decide your response (Jump!? Dash!? Shield?! Parry!?) The attacks remain the same, but you have a little more time to deal with them. You have control over how much the game slows down, and can even choose if you want the setting to kick in automatically during combat, or if you want to manually toggle it on when things get hairy. If there is one piece of advice I’d give players of Saros, it would be “Keep moving”. But, next to moving, the action you will likely be performing more than any other is shooting your weapon. The new “Auto-fire” accessibility setting makes your weapon fire automatically when you are aiming at a hostile. We know that some players may find it difficult to hold a button down for extended periods of time, so we hope this will help. More broadly, it gives you one less button to worry about during combat, freeing up your brain cycles to hit that dash button at just the right time to avoid taking a hit. Importantly, however, this setting does not make reloading automatic. A perfect reload still requires a well-timed button press. Like our other features, this is designed to make the game more accessible, not remove opportunities for player skill expression. Combined with the new Motion Sensor Aiming functionality and our existing button remapping settings, players now have many ways to customize how Saros controls. Beyond these new accessibility features, we have also greatly expanded the “Carcosan Modifier” system from Saros. Using this system, players can apply various “Modifiers” to the world of Carcosa to tune the difficulty to their liking. Protection Modifiers alter the game in a way that makes it easier and more forgiving. Zenith brings 10 new Protection Modifiers, to give players having a difficult time even more ways of customizing their experience. One of my favourite new Protections is “Corruption Melee Enhancement”. Corruption is one of the scariest mechanics in SAROS. When you get hit by certain projectiles, Corruption will build up on your Armor, eating away at your max Integrity. With this Modifier active, however, Corruption becomes a new source of power. When your melee strike connects with a hostile, your built up Corruption will be consumed and turned into additional damage, delivering a single devastating hit. The risk from Corruption still exists, but I hope this new way of dealing with it will encourage players to overcome their fear and get up close and personal in combat. Zenith also adds 10 new Trial Modifiers to increase the challenge level. A particularly tricky one is “Hostile Regeneration”. When playing with the Modifier, larger hostiles can be stunned via damage from your weapons, but they will quickly regenerate and recover. Only a melee strike can finish them off, so you need to be quick on your feet to rush in and deliver the fatal blow! These modifiers tie in directly to another of our brand new features: The New Game+ mode known as “Eclipse Layers”. After clearing Saros, mysterious new nodes will be added to the Armor Matrix back at Passage. These are the key to unlocking the gate to the next Eclipse Layer, a more intense version of the game with altered rules. After moving to the next Eclipse Layer, the first thing you will do is select a loadout of Carcosan Modifiers. In this mode, a certain threshold of Carcosan Modifiers must be met before you can begin. It will take multiple Trial Modifiers to reach this goal, but which ones you decide to take on is entirely up to you. With 25 different Trials to choose from, there is plenty of room to customize the challenge to fit your playstyle. But some strategic thinking is also advised, as certain combinations of Trials can synergize together to create deadly combinations… Another goal we had with Zenith was to give players a way to show off when they are playing with a bunch of difficult Trial Modifiers active. To do this, during the Eclipse Layers, Arjun now dons a Crown and his Armor glows golden! Better yet, the more Trials you take on, and the higher your Modifier Balance goes, the bigger and more splendid the Crown will become. Load up on those Trials, and see just how golden he gets! And the Crown is not just for show, it is also the key to a new collectable found in the Eclipse Layers. These “Visions” take the form of murals and messages, etched into stone by an ancient king. 12 Visions lay waiting across Carcosa, but as you walk the path, higher levels of the Crown will be required to perceive the additional story texts they contain. Last-but-not-least is the new Overlord Rush mode. This mode – accessed via the Primary Unit in Passage – brings you into an i

sources.title: Saros 2.0 Zenith Update Adds New Game+, Overlord Rush, and More Trophies
sources.text: HouseMarque has arrived with a massive new 2.0 update for Saros, adding a whole bunch of new content, including New Game+, a training simulation, trophies, Carcosan Modifiers, and more. Saros is a PlayStation exclusive released earlier this year from Returnal developer Housemarque. Now, as the year comes to a close, they have given players a free update that focuses on two things to make the game more replayable and accessible. Check out all the new additions below: The Saros 2.0 Zenith update is live and adds plenty of new content for players to explore. The first addition is Overlord Rush, an intense training simulation where players work to quickly defeat the Overlords from the main game, and you can compete with friends and players around the world on a new leaderboard. The new update also adds a New Game+ to the title, which players can try out after completing the main game. Each new Layer will also add more Trial Modifiers, and players can choose which Trials to play. Players also get a Crown and Armor that will glow golden after reaching Eclipse Layer 2. The glow keeps on increasing as the Carcosan Modifier balance increases. Players can also perceive truths previously hidden when moving to later Eclipse Layers, thanks to a new feature called Visions of King. Players will see murals and words from an old Yellow King etched in stone across Carcosa. The Saros 2.0 Zenith update also adds 20 new Carcosan Modifiers, split as 10 Protections and 10 Trials, with half available at the start of the game and the other half available in New Game+. Players also gain “Mastery” when defeating enemies with Carcosan Modifiers equipped, and it can eventually reach “Mastered” status. The update also adds six new trophies, unlocked by playing Overlord Rush, Eclipse Layers, and some of the new Carcosan Modifiers. Other than that, there are some new settings such as motion sensor aiming with the DualSense, Slow Game speed, new photo mode options, and balance updates that you can learn about in the Saros 2.0 patch notes below: What are your thoughts on the Saros 2.0 Zenith update? Leave your thoughts down in the comments, and join the official Insider Gaming Discord server . For more information from Insider Gaming, read about XBOX Game Pass removing 8 more games in October . Don’t forget to sign up for our weekly newsletter .

sources.name: PlayStation Blog BR
sources.title: Catálogo de jogos PlayStation Plus para outubro: Mafia: The Old Country, Horizon Forbidden West, Mycopunk e muito mais
sources.text: Dino Crisis 2 e RollerCoaster Tycoon 3 Complete Edition chegam no PlayStation Plus Deluxe. Neste mês, mergulhe no submundo do crime da Sicília do início do século XX em Mafia: The Old Country, enfrente uma fronteira mortal repleta de máquinas impressionantes em Horizon Forbidden West ou encare hordas de inimigos fúngicos com um arsenal extravagante de armas futuristas no jogo de ação cooperativa frenética Mycopunk, todos chegam no catálogo de jogos do PlayStation Plus já em outubro. Enquanto isso, o PlayStation Plus Premium recebe Dino Crisis 2 e RollerCoaster Tycoon 3. A lista completa de títulos estará disponível para jogar em 20 de outubro, salvo indicação em contrário. E, com a chegada da temporada de Halloween, os membros da PlayStation Plus podem aproveitar uma seleção de ofertas exclusivas como parte das nossas comemorações do Horrorfest. Confira os detalhes completos abaixo desta publicação. Descubra as origens do crime organizado nesta conturbada história de máfia ambientada no submundo brutal da Sicília do início do século XX. Lute para sobreviver como Enzo Favara e prove seu valor para a família nesta envolvente ação em terceira pessoa, que se passa em um momento histórico perigoso e implacável. Esta fantástica história ganha ainda mais vida com os visuais impressionantes, a narrativa cinematográfica e o realismo autêntico que consagrou a fama da aclamada série Mafia. A história de Enzo se passa em uma época em que a destreza com uma lâmina de estilete era letal, a espingarda lupara de cano cerrado era a arma de fogo preferida, vinganças sangrentas se prolongaram por décadas e os mafiosos patrulhavam seus territórios a pé, a cavalo ou ao volante dos primeiros automóveis. Acompanhe Aloy ao enfrentar o Oeste Proibido em uma fronteira majestosa, mas perigosa, que esconde novas e misteriosas ameaças. Explore terras distantes, enfrente máquinas maiores e mais imponentes e conheça novas tribos extraordinárias neste retorno ao futuro distante e pós-apocalíptico de Horizon. Reencontre velhos amigos, firme alianças com novas facções em conflito e desvende o legado de um passado ancestral — tudo isso enquanto tenta manter-se um passo à frente de um novo inimigo aparentemente invencível. Fatie alienígenas fúngicos neste jogo de tiro com saque baseado em missões e com altíssimo nível de personalização. Centenas de melhorias feitas à mão, modo cooperativo para 4 jogadores e um pequeno homem-barata. Como não amar? Um esquadrão de robôs rejeitados é contratado pela corporação SAXON e recebe uma última chance de conquistar a glória e alguns lucros (e evitar o ferro-velho). É a Equipe de Risco de Novo Atlas, um esquadrão de exterminadores em frangalhos enviado para descobrir os mistérios por trás de uma catástrofe fúngica que afeta todo o planeta. Embarque numa série de missões perigosas no planeta para afastar a ameaça micológica. Será um simples desastre natural como alegam? E será que a SAXON não fez direito a sua declaração de imposto de renda? Ou foi culpa sua? Mycopunk chega ao Catálogo de Jogos PlayStation dia 20 de outubro. Após um confronto com Huggy Wuggy e libertar Poppy, você deve descer mais fundo na fábrica de brinquedos da Playtime Co. Quebra-cabeças desafiadores e brinquedos horripilantes aguardam. Use ganchos, balance-se e abra caminho com força até a segurança. Tente escapar, e não deixe a mamãe encontrar você. Continue explorando as profundezas da Playtime Co. em busca de respostas. Sua jornada para descobrir o que aconteceu dentro da fábrica está apenas começando… Poppy Playtime: Chapter 2 estará disponível em 27 de outubro. Embarque em The Midnight Walk, uma aventura de fantasia sombria e reverente moldada em argila, criada pelas mentes por trás de Lost in Random, Fe e Ghost Giant. Torne-se o The Burnt One, faça amizade com uma criatura-lanterna perdida chamada Potboy e use a chama dele para iluminar seu caminho por um mundo de contrastes, repleto de maravilhas e horrores. Sobreviva e supere com astúcia os muitos monstros ávidos por devorar a chama do seu amiguinho enquanto vivencia cinco contos de fogo e escuridão, com um elenco incrível de personagens peculiares. Encante-se com cada detalhe perturbador de uma paisagem meticulosamente criada à mão com argila real e animada no estilo stop-motion. Totalmente jogável tanto no PS5 quanto em RV – com o PS VR2. The Midnight Walk estará disponível hoje, 14 de outubro. Tales of Arise – Beyond the Dawn Edition | PS5, PS4 Por 300 anos, Rena dominou Dahna, saqueando os recursos de seu planeta e privando as pessoas de sua dignidade e liberdade. Nossa história começa com duas pessoas nascidas em mundos diferentes, cada uma procurando mudar seu destino e criar um novo futuro. Com um elenco diversificado de personagens, um sistema de combate intuitivo e gratificante e uma história cativante ambientada em um exuberante mundo pelo qual vale a pena lutar, Tales of Arise oferece uma experiência de JRPG excelente. Tales of Arise – Beyond the Dawn Edition estará disponível em 27 de outubro. Monster Energy Supercross 25 – The Official Video Game | PS5 Vivencie a emoção de correr em pistas recém-projetadas que replicam eventos do mundo real e dispute com a mais recente lista de pilotos profissionais: abra o caminho em uma carreira renovada com competições intensas, rivalidades e escolhas estratégicas. Graças ao Unreal Engine 5, aproveite um gameplay renovado com física realista e evolução dinâmica da pista, tornando cada volta única e desafiadora. Domine o fluxo com tutoriais abertos, uma wiki abrangente e assistência de pilotagem da Neural Technology. Monster Energy Supercross 25 – The Official Video estará disponível em 27 de outubro. Um ano se passou desde os eventos de “Operação: Resgate do Dr. Kirk”. A pesquisa e desenvolvimento liderados pelo governo continuam para o projeto Third Energy do Dr. Kirk, conhecido por seu potencial em produzir fontes de energia limpa e sua capacidade de destruição em massa. sources.title: Mafia: The Old Country na PS Plus, GTA V em promoção e mais! Veja as indicações de games
sources.text: Mais um domingo que começa com a nossa lista semanal de indicações de jogos para ajudar você a escolher o que jogar nos próximos dias. O destaque da vez é Mafia: The Old Country , o capítulo mais recente da famosa franquia de ação em mundo aberto, está disponível de graça para assinantes dos serviços PS Plus Extra ou Deluxe. Outro destaque é GTA V . O icônico jogo da Rockstar está em promoção na Xbox Store por um dos menores preços já vistos para o título , sendo uma boa oportunidade para adquiri-lo antes do lançamento de sua sequência, GTA 6 . Confira a lista completa de indicações da semana! Red Dead Redemption 2 acompanha Arthur Morgan e a gangue Van der Linde em uma jornada pelos Estados Unidos mais precisamente no final do século XIX. O jogo oferece um mundo aberto vasto com missões principais, além de centenas de atividades secundárias, interações com personagens e gerenciamento de acampamento. O jogador explora diferentes regiões a cavalo ou a pé e precisa tomar decisões que afetam a honra do protagonista ao longo da campanha. Na PlayStation Store o título está disponível por R$ 74,97, o que representa um desconto de 75% em relação ao valor original. É uma ótima oportunidade para adquirir o game no PlayStation 4 por um preço reduzido. Mafia: The Old Country é o novo capítulo da franquia de ação com foco no crime organizado . A história desta vez é focada nas origens da máfia na Sicília, no início do século XX. O jogo traz mecânicas de tiro em terceira pessoa, condução de veículos da época e missões furtivas para avançar na hierarquia do crime e expandir a influência na região. O game está disponível de graça para os assinantes da PS Plus Extra e Deluxe. Os jogadores podem resgatar e aproveitar a campanha completa, sem custos adicionais, enquanto a assinatura do serviço estiver ativa. GTA V traz uma história com três protagonistas: Michael, Franklin e Trevor, na cidade fictícia de Los Santos. A campanha permite alternar entre os personagens durante missões de roubo, perseguições e tiroteios. Além disso, o game conta com um modo multiplayer online onde os jogadores podem criar seus avatares, comprar propriedades e realizar missões cooperativas. Na Xbox Store o título está com 50% de desconto, custando apenas R$ 99,45. É o momento perfeito para quem ainda não conferiu um dos melhores capítulos da franquia, especialmente antes do lançamento de GTA 6 no mês que vem. Valor Mortis é um jogo de ação com elementos de RPG e soulslike. Nele, o jogador controla um guerreiro em sua jornada para derrotar criaturas durante as Guerras Napoleônicas, onde forças de outro mundo marcam presença. sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Players on Steam so far seem delighted with Modern Warfare 4's campaign, making it one of the most well-received Call of Dutys in recent history
sources.text: It may be hard to believe, given all the Call of Duty: Modern 4 pre-launch community drama and the beta's lower-than-expected numbers on PC , but the final game may have turned things around - so far, at least. On Steam, Infinity Ward 's final chapter in the Modern Warfare sub-series currently has a Very Positive (92 percent) rating based on over 3,100 user reviews . Modern Warfare 4's campaign early access went live Friday, and the review rating has been improving steadily as players have experienced more of the campaign's missions. Many have likely finished it by now; the campaign is a little over six-hours in length, after all. Gaining access to the campaign on Friday required pre-ordering any of the game's editions digitally. Modern Warfare 4's official release isn't until 23rd October, which makes it hard to determine the current number of players, because SteamDB , our source for this data, can't reveal numbers without its tracking bot having a copy of the game. Setting aside player numbers, the sentiment around Modern Warfare 4 is considerably more positive at the outset compared to last year's Black Ops 7, currently sitting at Mostly Negative (37 percent) . While review ratings change over time with each major update, Modern Warfare 4 is currently the highest-rated Call of Duty in over a decade. However, it's worth bearing in mind that the people playing the game are likely the series' most keen players, so perhaps they're more lenient towards it. We haven't had a chance to review the game yet, having only received code late last week, but IGN published a COD: Modern Warfare 4 campaign review on Friday, scoring it 8/10. In the rebooted Modern Warfare series, the 2019 Modern Warfare game comes closest in average player sentiment with a Mostly Positive rating (79 percent) . 2022's Modern Warfare 2 is far lower with a Mixed rating (45 percent) . Outside of Infinity Ward's output, Black Ops: Cold War is close at Mostly Positive (79 percent) . Modern Warfare 4's next big moment is the anticipated release of DMZ, the game's extraction shooter mode. Like the campaign, DMZ is available early for pre-orders, unlocking tomorrow, 20th October . Finally, on 23rd October, traditional multiplayer becomes available, which is when we're likely to see a shift in user sentiment, if one is going to happen.

sources.title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines remaster rumoured, with leaker insisting it's not a remake
sources.text: A remaster of cult 2004 RPG Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines may be in the works. In a post on the r/GamingLeaksAndRumours subreddit , a user wrote: "I can confirm that it is in the works. NOT a Remake, but a Remaster, with some caveats. That's all I can say". The poster says they have "previously leaked info on multiple other games", including that Forza Horizon 6 is set in Japan, but of course, all we can do is treat this as an unsubstantiated rumour for now. Their post follows an earlier thread about a possible Bloodlines remake, which they describe as having "kind of leaked" the news already. Separately, another post on the subreddit, flagged "Grain of Salt", links to a thread about the band Genitorturers, which was involved with the original soundtrack, mentioning a Bloodlines remake. ICYMI, Bloodlines 2 wrapped up development in June with its final post-launch update. The leaker also describes a "dire situation" in the games industry, saying they "expect many games that are in development right now to not see the light of day".

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Metal band Genitorturers claims a Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines remake is coming, getting a dozen crusty nerds way too worked up
sources.text: October 18: The original Reddit post has now been corroborated by Nicholas Golden of the industrial metal group GLDN , who were on the same October 15 bill at The Meadows with Genitorturers. Eurogamer also reports that a user on the Gaming Leaks and Rumors subreddit—who allegedly demonstrated insider knowledge of Forza Horizon 6 prior to release—also claims a VtMB remaster (not a remake) is in development. Original Story: This one is thin , man, but it has to do with one of my favorite games of all time , while the circumstances of the rumor are just kind of neat and weird, even if it turns out to be nothing. User Few_Interview8222 on the Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines subreddit reported back from a Genitorturers show in Brooklyn, New York. Partway through the set, the band supposedly told the crowd that a VtMB remake is happening. Genitorturers played at Brooklyn's The Meadows as part of their "Live + Lewd Tour" on October 15. We've reached out to both rights-holder Activision (one of several, it's complicated) and Genitorturers' representation, and will update this story if we hear back. In addition to a killer score by Rik Schaffer , Bloodlines featured wonderfully era-appropriate licensed tracks from metal bands⁠—they were mostly used as diegetic music in the nightclubs and bars of Los Angeles. The Genitorturers track Lecher Bitch was the pitch-perfect theme of The Last Round, a downtown LA dive bar frequented by the Anarch faction of vampires. Multiple commenters on the Reddit thread point out that this could have been a confused, untimely, misinterpreted, or all of the above reference to last year's Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 . It's the sort of almost-but-not-quite thing you might expect from an artist with tangential awareness of a secondary fanbase they picked up over the years. A VtMB remake is also the sort of project you could see getting pingponged around between various actors and stakeholders: started, stopped, shopped around, etc. It'd be a situation ripe for collaborators on the periphery acting on outdated information. Rad! I think? It'd depend on who's doing it. More and more, I'm beginning to distrust anyone not named "Nightdive" when it comes to commercial remasters. See also: The recent Shogun 2 debacle and the fate of Deus Ex Remastered . Bloodlines is such a wild, janky, PC gaming package that Nightdive is the only studio I'd trust to not only do a remaster right, but also to bring on legendary modder Werner "Wesp5" Spahl, the man who's been keeping Bloodlines alive with one of the most impactful unofficial patch projects in gaming. A more ground-up remake would offer equally daunting challenges, like matching the one-of-a-kind mood and look Troika managed to evoke. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. Bloodlines is one of my very favorite games and an incredible RPG that's well worth your time. To the uninitiated, I like to pitch it as an evolutionary missing link between 2D Fallout and New Vegas. Bloodlines boasts the open-ended design and reactivity of Fallout in 3D for the very first time (Bloodlines leads Leonard Boyarsky and Jason Anderson were senior talent on Fallout 1). Unlike New Vegas' wide open world, however, Bloodlines had a more linear, but still loose sequence of zones on a world map to explore. Bloodlines' Y2K, gothic, noir interpretation of Los Angeles is one of the coolest worlds ever presented in an RPG. A Nightdive treatment would be my preferred outcome: build on Wesp5's work and compensate him accordingly, then make it more accessible on more platforms at a modest markup over the original game. Bloodlines 1 can be had for $20 on Steam and GOG , but it's practically always on sale. Even if it turns out to be nothing, this is still just a neat, newsworthy little incident to behold—Genitorturers shouting out an obscure, beloved RPG like this 22 years later, and maybe getting a couple genre nerds like me a little too excited on the way. 2026 games : All the upcoming games Best PC games : Our all-time favorites Free PC games : Freebie fest Best FPS games : Finest gunplay Best RPGs : Grand adventures Best co-op games : Better together Ted has been thinking about PC games and bothering anyone who would listen with his thoughts on them ever since he booted up his sister's copy of Neverwinter Nights on the family computer. He is obsessed with all things CRPG and CRPG-adjacent, but has also covered esports, modding, and rare game collecting. When he's not playing or writing about games, you can find Ted lifting weights on his back porch. You can follow Ted on Bluesky . stories.title: Video Game Decomp Hub Closes Due To AI: ‘The Community Aspect Of Decompilation Has Been Broken’
stories.summary: An integral step towards mods, ports and patches, the popular decomp.dev decided the platform has been rendered obsolete by 'drive-by contributions'

sources.name: Kotaku
sources.title: Video Game Decomp Hub Closes Due To AI: ‘The Community Aspect Of Decompilation Has Been Broken’
sources.text: When the major AI models updated in September, it seemed to usher in a tide of vibe coded havoc . The use of it in the modding community was divisive enough. Now dedicated platforms have been flushed and flustered by this new unprecedented wave. One popular platform, decomp.dev, has opted to throw in the towel . Not just because of how pervasive AI entries have become in their space, but for more philosophical reasons. They are a decompiling community, and they feel AI does not foster community. “It is now clear that, with the right guidance, human input, and code reviews, AI can expedite the decompilation process in a significant way,” writes the siteâs farewell message . “What is also now clear is that the community aspect of decompilation has been broken.” Founded in 2024, the site became a popular destination in the rapidly accelerating modding space. New tools and growing communities have made the rate of long-awaited translation patches and decompiles far more frequent, but the invasion of AI-generated decomps have fractured the scene. Decomp.devâs reasoning isnât anti-AI per se, but mournful in nature. Decompiling, in short, means disassembling and reassembling a game’s code. Once the structure is figured out, fans can construct all sorts of mods, ports and patches. The site’s closing statement says that recent models of Opus and GPT have been uncannily good at some of these practices, as if designed to do so. The consequence has been that anyone with a fistful of tokens can fish out their own. Decomp.dev feels that “drive-by contributions” have watered down the once collaborative spirit. If this is how things are going to be, then they feel a site such as this is obsolete. Itâs a new illustration in the continuing clash between those who enjoy these hobbies for camaraderie and those who want the most immediate, atomized experience imaginable. AI models may not have the ROM decomp communities in its sight but they certainly seem to be adept at cloning software. As reported by 404 Media in light of decomp.devâs closure, an AI suite from April was designed specifically to rip-off other programs within legally dubious frameworks. sources.name: Video Games Chronicle
sources.title: One of the biggest game decompilation sites is closing because AI has ‘broken the community aspect’
sources.text: “Bad actors” are abusing open source decomps in “increasingly troublesome ways”, it says One of the biggest sites dedicated to video game decompilations is sunsetting due to the growth of AI. In recent years, fan developers have been taking on a number of ‘decompilation’ projects, in which they take an existing game and reverse-engineer it into readable code. These decompilations â which are technically legal because the developers do not use any leaked content or copyrighted assets, and require players to provide their own legally-sourced ROMs â open up the ability to improve games further with support for higher frame rates, widescreen and ultrawide aspect ratios, dual-stick controls and other user-made mods. The growth of AI has led to issues, however, with the community divided on whether using AI for these projects is a positive step (because it makes it much quicker) or a negative one. Now the website Decomp.dev , which indexes decompilations and tracks those projects currently in progress, will be ‘sunsetting’, as announced by its creator @encounter. In a statement posted on the site’s homepage, @encounter notes that while they don’t believe AI is the main issue in itself, because when used properly and ethically it “can expedite the decompilation process in a significant way”, the “community aspect of decompilation has been broken” by people using AI in more questionable ways. “Our projects have always been open source to encourage contributions and to benefit the community as a whole,” they wrote. “Bad actors have been abusing this in increasingly troublesome ways.” @example explained that some people have been taking existing decompilation projects which are currently in progress, forking them and “finishing” them with AI. “Every project works differently,” they wrote. “Some may not want to use AI for legal or ethical reasons, and others may be okay with AI, or use AI themselves, but do not want drive-by contributions from folks who have put no effort into making sure the contributions are good. “The bottom line is that these kinds of hostile forks put little to no effort into meaningfully contributing to existing projects, tearing apart our community fabric.” They also noted that anyone with a subscription to an AI service can now make a basic port or ‘static recompilation’ which functions at a basic level, but doesn’t make it possible to add any new features. “Compared to the decompilation process itself, porting is relatively easy, especially with the established tools written by talented humans,” they wrote. “While community members put in the effort to decompile a game, opportunists have frequently raced to release a half-baked, barely-functional port from it.” Finally, they stated that one of the main reasons for decompiling games was to learn and research how they were put together, and that too many people using AI to create instant PC ports are calling them decompilations when in reality they have no understanding of how the code works. “For years, decompilation communities attempted to establish that decompilation is primarily for research,” they wrote. “We love these games and want to understand how they work, and to uncover the mysteries that the original developers left behind. “That’s not to say that ports aren’t fun too, they’re just not the sole reason a decompilation exists. Sloptubers and subreddits like /r/decomps have done immense damage here, freely using ‘decomp’ to mean ‘PC port’.” @example noted that the site â which lists numerous in-progress decompilation projects and includes progress bars showing how far along they are â was originally designed as a motivational tool for developers, but has now turned into a high score table by people rushing out AI-assisted ports. “Decomp.dev was originally designed to gamify decompilation â watching the progress go up was a fun way to stay motivated when every fraction of a percent took real human effort,” they explained. “Today, that same idea has warped decompilation into a hollow numbers game, exacerbated by folks who just want to burn tokens to make number go up or ‘port game to PC’, all else be damned. “While the increased attention has brought in genuine folks who want to learn and contribute meaningfully, I believe that decomp.dev serving as a public index and leaderboard is now causing more harm than good.” The site will continue to track existing projects and will “serve individual project pages and historical data”, but the main index of decompilations and the ability to add new projects have now been disabled. @example stressed again that while AI “can help tremendously when used correctly”, too many people are using it for “slop”, which “comes in many forms, is hard to define and even harder to moderate”. “As a sole hobbyist, I don’t have the energy (or desire) to define what makes a ‘good’ decompilation and enforce that consistently across the hundreds of projects on the site,” they concluded.

sources.text: Mais uma semana começando com a nossa lista de lançamentos de jogos, para que você possa programar a sua agenda para os próximos dias. E o destaque dessa vez é Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. O novo capítulo da famosa franquia FPS promete muita ação e adrenalina, dessa vez em uma guerra na Coreia do Sul. Outro destaque é Final Fantasy Resonance . O novo game da famosa franquia da Square Enix traz um sistema de combate em tempo real e gráficos que mesclam elementos pixelados com um visual modernizado. Confira a lista completa de lançamentos da semana, e os respectivos preços. Stupid Never Dies é um jogo de ação e sobrevivência em terceira pessoa. Ele acompanha um grupo de sobreviventes em uma cidade tomada por aberrações e criaturas mutantes. O enredo se desenrola em meio ao colapso urbano provocado por experimentos científicos malsucedidos, obrigando o jogador a explorar bairros abandonados, esgotos e instalações para descobrir a origem da contaminação. A jogabilidade combina combate a distância e corpo a corpo com a coleta de recursos espalhados pelo mapa. Conforme os jogadores avançam pelas missões, eles conquistam peças para fabricar armas, aprimorar a defesa e desbloquear habilidades na árvore de progressão de cada personagem. O jogo já está em pré-venda a partir de R$ 207,90, e conta com uma demo disponível gratuitamente. Final Fantasy Resonance acompanha a jornada de dois irmãos em um mundo onde a energia vital do planeta está se esgotando, devido ao uso descontrolado de tecnologias de amplificação mágica. A narrativa explora a busca pelas chamadas Relíquias de Ressonância, artefatos antigos capazes de restaurar o equilíbrio elemental antes que a degradação ambiental destrua as nações remanescentes. O jogo utiliza um sistema de combate em tempo real, mas com pausas táticas para a seleção de feitiços e comandos especiais. É possível controlar o líder do grupo e alternar o comando dos aliados durante as batalhas, criando sequências de ataques combinados e explorando as fraquezas elementais dos adversários. O game já está em pré-venda a partir de R$ 219,90, e possui uma demo que pode ser baixada de forma gratuita. Nintendo Switch Sports Resort é o novo título da franquia de jogos esportivos da Big N , que reúne diversas modalidades adaptadas para os controles do console. A lista de atividades inclui modalidades como basquete, golfe e arco e flecha, todos focados no uso de sensores de movimento. O controle das ações é realizado por meio dos sensores de movimento dos Joy-Con , exigindo gestos físicos para rebater bolas, ajustar a mira do arco ou dar braçadas nas competições marítimas. Além do modo carreira local, o game possui suporte para partidas multiplayer local e online. O jogo já está em pré-venda por R$ 279,90. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 dá continuidade aos eventos da franquia , com uma campanha focada na atuação da Força-Tarefa 141 em operações de contrainteligência global. A trama aborda a ascensão de uma aliança paramilitar clandestina que obteve acesso a armamentos autônomos, levando sua equipe a realizar missões de infiltração em diferentes regiões do mundo. No multiplayer, o título apresenta cenários inéditos para confrontos entre equipes, além do retorno de modos tradicionais de controle de zona e eliminação. O game também conta com uma mecânica que permite personalizar peças, miras e receptores das armas, mantendo a progressão compartilhada entre os modos de jogo. O título já está em pré-venda a partir de R$ 299,00. One Piece: Grand Gourmet é um cozy game focado na rotina de Sanji e da tripulação do Chapéu de Palha durante a navegação pela Grand Line. O enredo acompanha o grupo em uma competição culinária organizada entre ilhas, onde o objetivo é reunir ingredientes raros e derrotar piratas rivals para preparar os melhores pratos do oceano. A jogabilidade é dividida em duas fases principais. Na primeira, o jogador explora as ilhas controlando os membros do bando para enfrentar inimigos e recolher suprimentos. Na segunda etapa, a dinâmica muda para minigames de gerenciamento de tempo na cozinha do navio, onde é preciso preparar pedidos sob pressão e servir a tripulação. O jogo já está em pré-venda a partir de R$ 82,90. E na sua opinião, qual o game mais esperado da semana? Conte para a gente nas redes sociais do Voxel! sources.name: GamesIndustry.biz
sources.title: Samson studio Liquid Swords files for bankruptcy, staff reportedly unpaid for two months
sources.text: Swedish law firm Cirio acting as administrator, has filed a preliminary bidding document for developer Samson developer Liquid Swords has filed for bankruptcy after employees reportedly went unpaid for two months. The studio's administrator, Swedish law firm Cirio, published a preliminary bidding document for potential buyers last week. According to business site Breakit (via Game Talk ), employees petitioned for bankruptcy after not receiving pay for two months. Their salaries will be covered by the Swedish state wage guarantee . Earlier reports from Breakit stated that Liquid Swords faced "an acute liquidity shortage," with founder Christofer Sundberg commenting, "I don't think it can be resolved." All 27 employees are being dismissed as part of the bankruptcy. Cirio stated that their contracts "do not transfer with the business, and a takeover of staff requires that a buyer enter into new employment contracts with each employee." The preliminary bidding document stated that Liquid Swords' assets for sale "consist of intellectual property rights attributable to Samson," its debut title launched in April, "and the Company's other intellectual property, together with related development assets, equipment and inventory used in the Company's operations." The bidding window will conclude on October 21, 2026. Samson's unit sales and revenue were also included in the document. As of October 14, 2026, the game sold 151,900 copies, generating SEK 24.1 million ($2.4 million) in revenue. Avalanche co-founder Sundberg founded Liquid Swords in 2020 . In 2022, NetEase acquired an undisclosed minority stake in the company. Last February, Liquid Swords reduced its workforce for "the studio's long-term sustainability." The company did not specify how many employees were affected.

sources.title: Samson developer Liquid Swords is facing bankruptcy
sources.text: The studio behind open-world game has reportedly been declared bankrupt after months of unpaid developer wages Samson developer Liquid Swords has reportedly been declared bankrupt after its developers went unpaid for several months. According to Break It , the Swedish studio will now see the state step in to compensate its around 30 employees. At the same time, it hopes to find a buyer. Liquid Swords was co-founded in 2020 by Christofer Sundberg, who also co-founded Avalanche and was creative director on Just Cause. Its debut game, the open-world action title Samson, was released on Steam and the Epic Games Store in April to a mixed reception, with most criticism leveled at the number of bugs in the game. Sundberg later addressed criticism of the launch game , claiming that Liquid Swords âreleased a game with flaws for a number of reasons,â without explaining what those reasons were. âLaunching a game is a ton of work and Iâm proud of the effort our team has put into seeing Samson from its initial concept, through release,â he said, adding that Liquid Swords would âcontinue to keep our ears to the ground and improve the game with your supportâ. Samson was later released for consoles in September. In February 2025, the studio announced that it was making a round of layoffs , with Sundberg saying the company was in âa deeply regrettable position, with no choice but to begin the formal process of parting ways with some of our talented team membersâ

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Samson dev Liquid Swords has reportedly gone bankrupt
sources.text: Around 30 staff are affected, and the state will compensate them. Swedish studio Liquid Swords, maker of action game Samson, has reportedly been put into bankruptcy. Break It (thanks, PC Gamer ) reports that the studio's almost 30 employees will be compensated by the state, and that the bankruptcy trustee is looking for a buyer. The original report suggests Liquid Swords has not paid its developers for months, but the bankruptcy order, thought to have been issued on 12th October, should mean unpaid salaries will be covered by Sweden's state wage guarantee . Christofer Sundberg, who co-founded Just Cause developer Avalanche Studios , set up Liquid Swords in 2020. Samson: A Tyndalston Story, the studio's first game, launched on PC on 8th April, followed by PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on 21st September. The studio initially had difficulty securing a publisher, and reviews were ultimately mixed with players complaining of technical and performance issues. Liquid Swords is the latest studio hit by job losses. On 22nd September, Xbox confirmed 268 more layoffs and moved Rare and World's Edge under Activision, which will now develop the next Halo game, while Supermassive Games appears to have lost more than 70 staff earlier this month. Xbox also said that day it was beginning consultation on a proposed closure of Ninja Theory after two separate agreements for the studio fell through.
